summary: This code sets up a Docusaurus configuration that imports a custom plugin called remarkReplaceWords and registers it to run before the default remark plugins when processing blog content. The plugin will transform the markdown text according to whatever word-replacement rules it defines.

explanations.2: This imports a custom remark plugin from a local file; remark is a markdown processor, and plugins let you transform markdown before it's converted to HTML.
explanations.12: beforeDefaultRemarkPlugins is an array where you list plugins that should run before Docusaurus's built-in markdown processors, so your custom transformations happen first.
explanations.15: remarkReplaceWords is being added to that array, meaning it will be invoked to process the blog markdown files.
